data.name: Likhitha
data.gender_notes: Likhitha is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Likhitha is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Likhita' meaning 'written'. This name is believed to be given to a girl who is the embodiment of the Goddess Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth and prosperity. According to mythology, Lakshmi is often depicted as the one who writes down the good deeds of the devotees in her divine register. Therefore, the name Likhitha signifies being the 'daughter of God' or 'God's creation'.
data.etymology: Likhitha belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Daughter of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Likhitha total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
